I'm writing this as I play. (So now you know my IP...) I'm really enjoying the game.

It reminds me of an ancient Win 3.1 game called "Medieval War" which had a similar gameplay with tiles, troop pieces, and turns. I used to love that game when I was younger. It also had boats and different terrain effects.

Here are a couple of thoughts why I play:

  • Sometimes I want to move a piece, so I click it and select move, which just moves it in place. D'oh. Maybe don't allow zero-distance moving?

  • It's not clear to me which troops may capture and which cannot.

  • It would be nice to be able to swap two pieces. The Move action would be taken on both, but it would be better then having to take two days to swap them otherwise.

Nevertheless, very good work. What are your plans going forward? More development, more troops, different graphics?

That is great to hear! Makes all the hard work worth it :D

Yeah the movement is a little confusing for new players it seems :(. While it is one of those things that gets less confusing with time, it's clear to me that some amount of improvement needs to be made to the UI.

Basically, any of the footsoldier units can capture, I think what really throws people off is that the Mage cannot capture, even though it is human-like in appearance. Maybe that will be my next buff to mage if it ever merits another one, haha.

Swapping is an interesting idea! I had a couple requests for a "delete" unit button, but a swap would be a lot more resourceful. I'm still trying to figure out how it will impact choke points. Since the game is so new I'm just trying to gather as much information as I can right now.

As for future plans, I received a lot of requests for player-created AI services and I think I know an easy way to do that so I'm gonna probably be doing that next or at least very soon.

I'll probably make more units as I see fit to balance the game and create more interesting strategies, but I definitely want to make more maps constantly. And while the game SORELY needs new graphics, I don't have any artist friends that are willing to take on the job, so the placeholder art stays for now.

I love hearing that people are enjoying the game! Thanks so much for the feedback and suggestions :D
